summary:
Reviewed w246 commit 0b306638 (supervise_merge.py and two test files, all in the fileset; nothing under features/ changed).
Finding 1 of branch review 1 is fixed: a refused merge's question gives each failed run before the merge that names a scenario that failed again alone, then the second runs (r220).
Finding 2 is fixed: the rerun log line is gone. Two rerun-log assertions were removed; both are listed in plan part 4 and both allowances hold.
The new unit test pins both fixes. tools check: nothing in the touched files. tools size: nothing over 300 lines.
Two Minor findings: matching node ids as substrings can add an extra first run to the question (observation); one long docstring line (drop).
The red run cannot be seen from the commit, but it is consistent with the old code.
